name: I-TB (iSifo sePhepha)
tagline: Ukukhohlela iiveki ezi-2+? Uvavanyo namhlanje - unyango lusimahla.

urgent.heading: Kungxamisekile - bona ikliniki kule veki
urgent.primary_message: Ukukhohlela ngaphezu kweeveki ezi-2, ukukhohlela igazi, ukubila kakhulu ebusuku, okanye ukuncipha ngokukhawuleza komzimba - yiya ekliniki. Uvavanyo lusimahla.
red_flags: Ukhohlokhohlo oluhlala ngaphezu kweeveki ezi-2 - luvelisa okanye lomile
Ukumanzisa ebusuku ukubila ixesha elingaphezu kweveki
Iintlungu zesifuba eziye ziba mandundu xa uphefumla
Abantwana abanokhohlokhohlo oluzingisileyo kunye nokusilela ukuphumelela

what_is_it.heading: I-TB ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Isifo sephepha lusulelo lwebhaktiriya olubangelwa yiMycobacterium tuberculosis. Ngokuqhelekileyo ihlasela imiphunga kodwa inokuchaphazela naliphi na ilungu lomzimba - amathambo, ingqondo, izintso, i-lymph nodes.
paragraphs: I-TB isasazeka emoyeni xa umntu osulelekileyo ekhohlela okanye ethimla. Abantu abaninzi abavezwayo abaguli ngoko nangoko - ibhaktiriya inokuhlala ingasebenzi iminyaka (i-TB esafukamileyo) phambi kokuba iqalise ukusebenza. Malunga ne-1 kwi-10 usulelo olufihlakeleyo luba sisifo esisebenzayo ebomini.

I-TB iyanyangeka. Unyango oluqhelekileyo ziinyanga ezi-6 zeepilisi zemihla ngemihla — simahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zaseMzantsi Afrika. Eyona ngozi inkulu kukuyeka unyango kwangoko xa uziva ngcono. Unyango olungaphelelanga luzala i-TB enganyangekiyo ngamachiza, ekunzima kakhulu kwaye ixesha elide ukuyinyanga.

items.body: Iimeko ezitsha ze-TB eMzantsi Afrika minyaka le. Elinye lawona mazinga aphezulu ehlabathini.

items.headline: 100% simahla
items.body: Lonke uvavanyo, zonke tablet, lonke utyelelo. Unyango lwe-TB engeva yeza nalo lusimahla. Akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Iinyanga ezi-6 zamayeza emihla ngemihla ziyinyanga ngokupheleleyo i-TB eqhelekileyo. I-TB engeva yeza ithatha ixesha elide kodwa iyanyangeka.

items.headline: I-HIV iphinda kabini umngcipheko
items.body: I-TB ngoyena nobangela wokusweleka kwabantu abaphila ne-HIV. Ukuba ngaba une-HIV, zivavanyelwe i-TB ngalo lonke ixesha undwendwela.

pull_quote.text: Ukuyekisa iipilisi ze-TB xa uziva ubhetele yeyona nto iyingozi onokuyenza - kuwe nakubo bonke abantu abakungqongileyo. I-TB engeva yeza iqala mhla umntu eyeka unyango lwakhe.

signs.heading: Yintoni omawuyibukele
signs.lede: I-TB idla ngokuvela kancinane. Uphawu lwakudala lukhohlokhohlo olungasoze luhambe. Naluphi na ukhohlokhohlo oluhlala ngaphezu kweeveki ezi-2 lufanele uvavanyo.

items.title: Ukhohlokhohlo oluzingisileyo
items.description: Ukhohlokhohlo oluhlala ngaphezu kweeveki ezi-2, ludla ngokuvelisa, ngamanye amaxesha ngegazi. Isenokuba worse ebusuku.

items.title: Ukubila ebusuku kunye nomkhuhlane
items.description: Ukubila ebusuku okumanzisa okumanzisa amashiti. Umkhuhlane ophantsi, ngakumbi emva kwemini nangokuhlwa.

items.title: Ukunciphisa umzimba kunye nokudinwa
items.description: Ukulahleka kwesisindo ngokungeyomfuneko kwiiveki okanye iinyanga. Ukulahlekelwa ngumdla wokutya. Ukudinwa ngaphandle kokulingana nomsebenzi.

items.title: Ebantwaneni
items.description: Ukungaphumeleli ukuphumelela, ukutyeba kakubi, ukukhohlela okuzingileyo, ukudumba kwamadlala entanyeni. I-TB ebantwaneni isoloko iphoswa — buza ukuba isizalwane esisondeleyo sine-TB na.

spreads.heading: Isasazeka njani i-TB — kwaye ayisasazeki njani
yes: Ukuphefumla amathontsi omntu one-TB yemiphunga ephilayo ekhohlelayo okanye ethimla
Uqhagamshelo olusondele ixesha elide kwiindawo ezivaliweyo, ezingenamoya kakuhle
Ukuhlala okanye ukusebenza kwiimeko ezixineneyo - amakhaya, iihostele, imigodi, iintolongo
Ukusela ubisi olungaxutywanga kwiinkomo ezosulelekileyo (zinqabile eMzantsi Afrika)
no: Ukudibana okuqhelekileyo njengokuxhawula izandla okanye ukuba kwindawo enye ngaphandle
Ukwabelana ngokutya, iziselo, iipleyiti, okanye i-cutlery
Izihlalo zangasese, amaqhosha ecango, okanye izinto zokulala (sakuba zivuliwe)

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzikhusela wena nosapho lwakho
prevention.lede: I-TB iyakhula kwiindawo ekungangeni moya ngazo kakuhle, kwiindawo ezixineneyo. Uninzi lothintelo lumalunga nomoya, ukubhaqwa kwangoko, kunye nokugqibezela unyango - olwakho okanye lomfowunelwa wekhaya.

items.title: Ugonyo lwe-BCG ekuzalweni
items.description: Usana ngalunye lwaseMzantsi Afrika lufumana inaliti ye-BCG ekuzalweni kwayo. Ayithinteli yonke i-TB kodwa yehlisa iintlobo ezinzima ebantwaneni, ngakumbi i-meningitis.

items.title: Vula iifestile
items.description: Iibhaktheriya ze-TB zifa ngokukhawuleza emoyeni omtsha nakukukhanya kwelanga. Vula iifestile, ngakumbi kumagumbi okulala ahlala kunye nomntu onyangwa i-TB.

items.title: Vavanya abafowunelwa basekhaya
items.description: Ukuba umntu okwikhaya lakho ufunyenwe, wonke umntu osendlwini kufuneka avavanywe-nokuba uziva ephilile. Abantwana bafuna ukukhuselwa ngokukhethekileyo.

items.title: Unyango lothintelo lwe-TB
items.description: Abantu abaphila ne-HIV, abafowunelwa basekhaya, kunye namanye amaqela asemngciphekweni banokunikwa ikhosi yeepilisi ze-TB ukuthintela isifo esisebenzayo. Buza kwikliniki yakho.

items.fact: I-TB ichaphazela onke amaqela emivuzo. Amazinga aphezulu e-SA avela ekungeneni komoya okulambathayo, ukuxinana, kunye nekhonkco le-HIV - kodwa nabani na ochitha ixesha kwindawo evaliweyo ene-TB eqanduselayo uyabhencwa.

items.myth: Xa ndiziva ngcono, ndiyakwazi ukuyeka iipilisi.
items.fact: Ukuyeka kwangoko yindlela ekhula ngayo i-TB enganyangekiyo ngamachiza. Kufuneka ugqibe iinyanga ezi-6 ezipheleleyo - nokuba awusakhohlisi kwaye sele ubuyile emzimbeni.

items.myth: Iipilisi ze-TB zonakalisa isibindi nentliziyo — amayeza endalo angcono.
items.fact: Iipilisi ze-TB azifane zibe neziphumo ebezingalindelekanga zesibindi, ezijongwayo. Kodwa i-TB enganyangwanga iyabulala ngokuqinisekileyo. Alikho iyeza lendalo elakhe lanqanda ibhaktheriya ye-TB.

items.myth: Ukuba utya kakuhle kwaye womelele, ungayilwa i-TB ngokwakho.
items.fact: Isondlo esilungileyo siyawunceda umxokomezelo wokhuselo lomzimba, kodwa akukho kutya kukodwa kunokuphelisa i-TB eqanduselayo. Amayeza okubulala iintsholongwane lolona nyango lusebenzayo. Yitya kakuhle KWAYE usele iipilisi.

items.title: Ukuba ubunokhohlokhohlo kangangeeveki ezi-2 - zivavanye
items.description: Ngena kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki. Cela uvavanyo lwe-TB. Uya kucelwa ukuba ukhuphe isikhohlela kwikomityi encinci. Iziphumo ngeentsuku ezimbalwa.

items.title: Ukuba unayo - qala unyango ngokukhawuleza
items.description: Ikliniki iya kukunika iipilisi kwangaloo mini. Unyango lwemihla ngemihla, lujongwe kwisigaba sokuqala, kwaye simahla.

items.title: Thatha yonke idosi, yonke imihla, kwiinyanga ezi-6 ezipheleleyo
items.description: Ungaze utsibe. Ungaze uyeke kwangoko - nokuba uziva ngcono ngokupheleleyo emva kweeveki ezimbalwa. Ukutsiba kuzala i-TB engeva yeza.

items.title: Xelela ikhaya lakho kunye nabafowunelwa abasondeleyo
items.description: Bonke kufuneka bavavanywe. Abantwana abangaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kunye nabasetyhini abakhulelweyo bafuna ukubonwa ngokukhawuleza. Iklinikhi inceda ngokukhangelwa koqhagamshelwano.

items.title: Ukuba kunyango lwe-HIV - ziqhube zombini
items.description: Unyango lwe-TB ne-HIV lusebenza kunye. Xelela ikliniki ngawo onke amayeza akho. Ungaze uyeke enye ukuze wenze enye ibe lula.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo lwe-TB yenye yezona nkqubo zisekiweyo kwimpilo yoluntu eMzantsi Afrika. Hamba uye kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki - akukho dinga, akukho ncedo lwezonyango, akukho ID efunekayo.
